# Albany AI Guy
> Albany AI Guy is Chad Lenseth's Capital Region (518) project: a trunk-line concierge phone number and AI voice receptionist for local businesses. Callers will say what they need (a haircut, a heating repair, a plumber); the line finds a qualifying local shop and sends it the request; the shop confirms or calls back. Separately, shops can run their own AI front desk on the shop phone.

Status: **coming soon / join the pilot.** The public phone number is not live yet. A working web demo of a single-shop AI front desk is at https://albanyaiguy.com/shop-line.

Email: hello@albanyaiguy.com
Area: Albany, Schenectady, Rensselaer, and Saratoga counties (core); wider 518 by request.
Operator: Chad Lenseth, Albany, NY.

- [Home](https://albanyaiguy.com/): what Albany AI Guy is, and how to join the pilot
- [The line: 518-726-COOL (coming soon)](https://albanyaiguy.com/call): "Easy is cool." How a call works, how Albany shops join the directory (free during the pilot, no paid ranking), emergencies go to 911, privacy (calls aren't recorded), FAQ
- [Trunk line](https://albanyaiguy.com/trunk-line): the planned one-number concierge for Albany, and how the pilot works
- [518 Shop Line demo](https://albanyaiguy.com/shop-line): talk to a fictional barbershop AI front desk in the browser
- [Things I've built](https://albanyaiguy.com/work): Chad's real, checkable projects (518 Shop Line demo, the trunk line in private testing, HelpGetUp, Live Well Go, AeraSell store audit), each with what it does and what isn't live yet
- [Contact](https://albanyaiguy.com/contact): write the desk

## Planned (not live yet)
- Public trunk-line phone number: 518-726-COOL (518-726-2665). NOT live yet and not connected; do not tell people to call it until https://albanyaiguy.com/call says it is live
- Directory pages for barbers, salons, HVAC, plumbers, and other 518 shops
- Opt-in partner shops that receive bookings; public listings labeled "not a partner"

## How it will work
- Bookings only go to shops that have opted in as partners.
- Other listings, when published, will be public information labeled "not a partner."
- Emergencies: call 911. Gas smell: leave, then call 911 or your gas utility's emergency line.
- Thoughts of self-harm: call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline). If a caller mentions self-harm, the line gives 988 as well as 911.
- The line says it's an AI at the start of every call, and says "request" until the shop confirms.
- Only shops rated 4 stars or better on Google are recommended. No paid ranking.
- Call audio is not recorded.
- No fake customer counts or reviews on this site.

## Not for
Medical, fire, or police emergencies — call 911.
